questions.text: Perfect, that gives me the whole evening. Now I need somewhere to take her. What does she actually love eating? She always just says, “Anything.”
questions.hint: Look for an album in the Photos app that might contain clues about her culinary preferences.

questions.text: Sushi. Of course — I can't stand it, but if it makes her happy, I'll smile through it. She's mentioned one place twice. Could you give me their phone number?
questions.hint: Start with Notes to find a list of restaurants. Then search the phone contacts for the restaurant mentioned in the note.

questions.text: They've held us a table. One more thing and then I'll stop, I promise. She's been on that phone at midnight night after night for weeks now — what's the name of the site she keeps checking?
questions.hint: First, look in Notes for a code to access private browsing. The note may be saved under a familiar name, so don't assume it's the site you're looking for. Once you find the right code, open Safari and access private browsing to see the hidden tabs.

questions.text: I've never heard of it. I've been staring at that name for a minute and I don't want to ask, but — when did she first access that site?
questions.hint: Open Gmail and check the deleted emails. Look for the welcome email Wildflower sent the first time she signed in.

questions.text: Okay. People sign up for things and forget about them, it doesn't have to mean anything. Find out if she's actually paying for it and how much it costs every month. I need the exact amount.
questions.hint: Open Wallet and look in the transaction history. Find the Wildflower subscription payment and check the amount.

questions.text: She's actually paying for a dating site every month... That's not curiosity, that's not a leftover account. I need the count and I'd rather have it straight. How many women has she started up with on there?
questions.hint: Explore the messaging apps: Messages, WhatsApp and Instagram. Look for conversations that could be from people she met on Wildflower. Count the total number of people contacted.

questions.text: Three. Three women. And the night she said she was at the studio she never came home at all — please, can you tell me where she actually slept?
decoys: Bde Maka Ska lake view studio
questions.hint: Open Messages and read her texts with Marin to find the night she said she'd sleep at the studio. On Instagram, her chat with @camille_b_films shows that studio night was covering for a booking. Then check the Airbnb app.

onboarding.text: Okay, so — nothing's wrong. I want that said first. I'm just... I'm about to do something enormous and I can't do it on my own.
onboarding.label: Marin

onboarding.text: Blythe does interiors — our kitchen counter is permanently covered in paint testers. Six months, one apartment in Minneapolis. A week from tonight I'm asking her to marry me. I've practiced it in the car.
onboarding.label: Marin & Blythe

onboarding.text: There's another thing, and I hate saying it out loud. Every night this month I wake up and her face is lit blue. Two nights ago she didn't come home. She said the studio.
onboarding.label: Blythe

onboarding.text: Her phone's charging in the hall. I feel sick doing this... An evening she's free, a place she'd love, a number I can ring. Then tell me what she's looking at in the dark.
onboarding.label: Marin
